fo.command:
exec kitty --class otter-tools -e bash -c 'f="$(fd --type f --hidden --exclude .git --exclude .cache . "$HOME" 2>/dev/null | fzf --cycle --gutter '"'"' '"'"' --pointer '"'"'▌'"'"' --color '"'"'bg:#183039,bg+:#183039,fg:#C5D6D8,hl:#0ABAB5,pointer:#0ABAB5'"'"' --prompt '"'"'  File > '"'"' --preview '"'"'bat --color=always --style=numbers {+} 2>/dev/null || cat {+}'"'"' --preview-window=right:50%:wrap)"
if [ -n "$f" ]; then
    setsid -f xdg-open "$f" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
exit 0
'

yz.command:
exec kitty --class otter-tools -e bash -c 'd="$(fd --type d --hidden --exclude .git --exclude .cache . "$HOME" 2>/dev/null | fzf --cycle --gutter '"'"' '"'"' --pointer '"'"'▌'"'"' --color '"'"'bg:#183039,bg+:#183039,fg:#C5D6D8,hl:#0ABAB5,pointer:#0ABAB5'"'"' --prompt '"'"'  Dir > '"'"')"
if [ -n "$d" ]; then
    setsid -f kitty -e yazi "$d" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
exit 0
'

ldk.command: kitty --override background=#080D10 -e lazydocker 2>/dev/null || kitty -e bash -c 'echo "lazydocker not installed. yay -S lazydocker"; read'

jq.command:
kitty -e bash -c '
echo "  jq interactive — paste JSON below, Ctrl+D when done:"
echo " ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
json="$(cat)"
echo ""
echo "  Result:"
echo "$json" | jq . 2>&1
echo ""
read -p "  Press Enter..."
'

rn.command: kitty --class rednotes-float -e bash -c 'export SHELL=/bin/bash; rednotes manage'

rna.command: kitty --class rednotes-float -e bash -c 'export SHELL=/bin/bash; rednotes add'

rnt.command: exec kitty --class rednotes-float -e bash -c 'export SHELL=/bin/bash; rednotes set "$1"; read -r -p "Target set. Enter..."' otter "$OTTER_ARGUMENT"

nm.command: exec kitty -e bash -c 'nmap -T4 -F "$1"; read -r -p "Done. Press Enter..."' otter "$OTTER_ARGUMENT"

upd.command: kitty -e bash -c 'sudo pacman -Syu; read -p "Done. Press Enter..."'

snap.command: kitty -e bash -c 'sudo snapper -c root list; read -p "Press Enter..."'

wifi.command:
if command -v impala &>/dev/null; then
  kitty --override background=#080D10 -e impala
else
  kitty --override background=#080D10 --override foreground=#C5D6D8 -e nmtui
fi

bt.command:
if command -v bluetuith &>/dev/null; then
  kitty --override background=#080D10 --override foreground=#C5D6D8 --class bluetooth -e bluetuith
else
  kitty --override background=#080D10 --override foreground=#C5D6D8 -e bluetoothctl
fi

ip.command:
kitty -e bash -c '
echo "  LOCAL:"
ip -4 addr | grep inet | grep -v 127 | awk "{print \"  \" \$2}"
echo ""
echo "  EXTERNAL:"
curl -s https://ipinfo.io/ip && echo
echo ""
read -p "  Press Enter..."
'
